label: prop:c5-involution-leibniz-decomposition
title: $c_5$ decomposes as $-b^2 - 1/2$: pure-$\sigma$ Kashiwara contribution plus bar-invariant involution fingerprint from averaged-crossing structure. Interpretation of the unique averaging-resonant rung k = 5 identified in `thm:averaging-resonance-rule` (planned, not yet derived); involution supplies the $1/2$ magnitude, while the half-fill cyclic structure supplies the rung selection.
html:
Let c_5(q) be the precision-ladder coefficient at rung N=5 in the \mathfrak{Q}_\beta categorical formula (prop:q-beta-categorical-precision-ladder). Then c_5 admits the categorical decomposition:

\boxed{\;
c_5(q) \;=\; \underbrace{-b(q)^2}_{\text{pure-}\sigma\text{ Kashiwara}}
\;-\; \underbrace{\tfrac{1}{2}}_{\substack{\text{averaged-crossing}\\\text{involution fingerprint}}}
\;}

where b(q)^2 = (q^4+q^2+1)/(q^2+1)^2 is the Hoefsmit off-diagonal coupling squared on V_{(2,1)}. The -1/2 summand is the fingerprint of the bar-invariant averaged-crossing operator \sigma_{\text{avg}} = (\sigma + \sigma^{-1})/2 used at specific positions in the typed-\mathbf{B}_3 braid recipe (prop:neutron-qvalue-symbolic).

The decomposition resolves the Pell-Lucas outlier status of c_5 at the silver ratio (prop:silver-ratio-beta-decay-null). The pure-\sigma part -b^2 evaluates to -7/8, and the involution fingerprint -1/2 is the non-Hecke correction.
